author: Jonathon Fordham
text: The food tastes amazing and taking advantage of the offers it is great value. Atmosphere is good and staff are very friendly. Have been twice now and will definitely go back!

author: Paul Goodwin
text:
We came here on a Thursday evening. Luckily we got a table as soon got busy.
Sadly we didn’t get the name of our server but she was knowledgeable about the menu and keen to cater to our needs. The young lady with fair hair. So please give her recognition. 👍
The food was absolutely outstanding. My wife and I are very well travelled so pleased to say the food was authentic and tasted amazing.
Great atmosphere about the place good music volume and full with fellow guests.
We can’t wait to return. ❤️
